subject: art-design
source_note: Structure follows the IB Diploma Visual Arts guide: theoretical, art-making and curatorial practices, assessed through the comparative study, process portfolio and exhibition. HL requires greater breadth and depth (more art-making forms, more exhibited works, and connecting own work in the comparative study). Component names are guide-accurate; connections, sequence and prerequisites are expert-authored teaching relationships (the IB does not publish these).
